in_sanskrit.name: उत्कर्ष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the root 'ut' meaning 'up' or 'over' and the root 'karsh' meaning 'to do, to make, to cause'. Utkarsha can be interpreted as 'one who causes progress' or 'one who causes growth'.

in_hindi.name: उत्कर्ष
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi term 'उत्तिष्ठना (uttishaṇa)' can be translated to 'to rise, to awaken, to arise, to emerge'. Utkarsha can be interpreted as 'one who rises, awakens, arises, or emerges'. This name can also be associated with the Hindu deity Shiva, who is often depicted as 'Utpat (the awakened one)'.

in_tamil.name: உத்கர்ச்சா
in_tamil.long_meaning: From the Tamil root 'ut' meaning 'up' or 'over' and the root 'karsh' meaning 'to do, to make, to cause'. Uthkarshaa can be interpreted as 'one who causes progress' or 'one who causes growth'.

in_telugu.name: ఉద్యోజేశ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: From the Telugu root 'udu' meaning 'up' or 'over' and the root 'yoj' meaning 'to go' or 'to join'. Udhyojesh can be interpreted as 'one who causes progress' or 'one who causes growth'.

in_marathi.name: Utkarsha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Utkarsha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Utkarsha means 'progress' or 'growth'. This name is often given to babies who are expected to make great strides in their lives, and is a reminder that with hard work and determination, one can overcome any obstacle.
